notes.title: February Update - New Influence System, Decorative Buildings and more!
notes.content:
Greetings fair Nysians, 

We’re excited to share that our next update includes key features that are arriving a full month ahead of schedule (as part of our Early Access roadmap). The Influence System, Decorative Buildings and Improved Wyrmaxa were all completed earlier than anticipated, and rather than holding it back, we want you to experience it as soon as possible. By releasing it early, we’re also ensuring a smoother rollout - our goal is always to deliver the best possible experience and we can’t wait for you to dive into the world of Nysamor and check it out for yourselves. 

We also want to say a massive thank you to the Thrive Discord community for their support and time during the update early preview period this week,  and to everyone for your support throughout Early Access so far. Your time, and feedback has been truly invaluable in helping us bring our vision for the game to life.

Now is the perfect time for you and your friends to jump in and defend Nysamor together, and experience all the new additions, fixes, and quality of life improvements in Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown!
[b][h2]New Features[/h2][/b]
[b]New:[/b]
[list][*] Influence System
[*] Decorative Buildings[list]
[*] Reduces pollution and increases happiness[/list][*] Wyrmaxa Attack Raids
[list][*] Wyrmaxa attacks your territories when at war.
[*] Assaults occur every 5 days and get progressively harder.
[*] Small Improvement to Wyrmaxa AI pathing in combat.[/list][*] Updated Wall Placement System
[list][*] Walls place and connect easier [/list][*] Difficulty Settings added
[list][*] Normal
[list][*] Start with higher happiness
[*] Increased production speed
[*] Less fires
[*] Adjusted villager threshold for villager needs[/list][/list][*] Hard
[list][*] Original game difficulty[/list][/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list][*] Provinces becoming neutral after claiming
[*] De-Sync in multiplayer
[*] Unit placement on stone walls
[*] Small fixes for influence, initial caravan uses influence, influence tool tip only shows on buildings that cost influence
[*] Aqueduct buildings now graphically show whether they are powered or not
[*] Entertainment buildings providing happiness bonus when they have no one working there
[*] Catapult start position and wall placement amended

[*] Game saves not showing up in game

[*] Camera issues on loading game while camera is over a mountain
[*] Localization not updating in-game

[*] Military units phasing through walls when in formations
[*] Multiplayer save name error bug
[*] Homeless people showing up in the houses in the wrong territories
[*] Adjust layout of influence & wealth tooltip to ensure German & Russian translations aren’t cut off

[*] Lag when typing save name

[*] Outposts failing to clear zone when all buildings destroyed
[*] Riots always being called
[*] Tutorial localization improved
[*] Beasts eating
[*] Balancing changes to farmer needs
[*] Road tiles drawing at node navigation points[/list]
[b][h2]Decorative Buildings [/h2][/b]
We’ve added new buildings and structures so you now have the ability to decorate your cities in a unique way! Not only can you customize your kingdom to make it feel full of life, but each structure counterbalances pollution and beautification, and improves the happiness of your population. They also give bonuses to surrounding buildings such as happiness, taxes, production, movement speed and influence. 

Different structures unlock at different points throughout the game with neutral buildings, as well as Benevolent and Tyrannical-specific options as your kingdom progresses down one of the two paths. 

[b]Neutral Decorations[/b]
[list][*] Trees - 23 Variations
[*] Hedges - 3 Variations[/list]
[b]Benevolent specific decorations[/b]
[list][*] Bench, Flag Pole, Flower Bed, Fountain, Graveyard, Hedge Maze, Pony Ride, Statue, Streetlight[/list]
[b]Tyrannical specific decorations[/b]
[list][*] Obelisk, Flag Pole, Streetlight, Crypt, Graveyard, Statue, Hanging Cage, Spiked Heads, Torture Rack[/list]
[b][h2]Influence System[/h2][/b]
In Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown, we have created an Influence system that limits the amount of provinces and military units in your game. It acts like a currency that is spent to acquire more of these things!

Once these items are lost or destroyed, the currency is returned. You will start the game with a small amount of Influence and when your population increases, or you upgrade your Keep, you will gain more Total Influence.

You will start with an amount (100) and increase it as your population grows and you reach the next tier. Every certain amount of global population will get a one time boost in Total Influence. The top tier class of each Benevolent and Tyrannical paths, will increase influence at a much quicker rate. 

Influence is a permanent currency that when used reduces the amount and when items that used it are lost or destroyed, the currency is returned to the pool. Acquiring more provinces, having alliances with towns or players, military units and caravans spend influence

notes.title: New Update - New Militia, Riots & more!
notes.content:
Greetings fair Nysians, 

As part of our Early Access roadmap, our latest update is available now! 

We also wanted to say a special thank you to the Thrive community in our Discord who have taken the time to be a part of our save and load build testing this week, and to everyone for your support throughout Early Access so far. Your time, and feedback has been truly invaluable in helping us bring our vision for the game to life. 

Now is the perfect time for you and your friends to jump in and defend Nysamor together, and experience the quality of life improvements in Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown!

[b]Added:[/b]
[list][*] Hired militia units for early-game defense
[*] Citizen revolts
[*] Optimizations to the Save/Load system to reduce time taken for each action
[*] Ability to hover on town to display town name
[*] New road rendering system for better performance
[*] Notification when the merchant arrives in town
[*] Notification for when a player creates a trade route with a different team in multiplayer mode[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list][*] The defeat screen allowing players to go back to main menu and can no longer continue the game
[*] How happiness items are displayed in the UI
[*] Edicts not activating correctly when loading a save
[*] Missing translations for ‘progress’ text during construction of buildings 
[*] Benevolent Quarry graphics
[*] Progress text on Construction module when translated
[*] Units now face the proper direction when rioting, spread out more and move more as a group 
[*] Removed unreachable resources from territory borders so villagers can farm those resources.
[*] Baked overworld road pathfinding to have more consistent shorter paths
[*] Translations on Onboarding ‘One Off’ Item displays
[*] Translations on Caravans ToolTip
[*] Texture issues with the building ground decals
[*] Improvements to overworld road pathfinding
[*] Building loading system
[*] Deleting Bridges not updating navigation map
[*] Military unit names not appearing in tooltip on multi military unit UI
[*] Military hotkey UI to show the proper hotkeys
[*] Localisation of narrative event rewards
[*] Localisation of secondary onboarding objective titles (such as the ones triggered by fires and disease)
[*] Missing information from Bevevolent/Tyrannical classes in stats panel
[*] Issues with Tome of Knowledge and Stats panel extending off-screen in 16:10 aspect ratio
[*] Bug where a storage would display a negative amount
[*] Caravan farmers no longer stuck at loading 9/10
[*] 'Caravans' info panel no longer fails to localize in any language in the 'Resource bar' in the top left UI
[*] Cinematic Audio settings
[*] Resource flag AOI and highlights
[*] Z & X keys overriding modified squad controls
[*] Onboarding objective display cut off in 16:10 aspect ratio
[*] Caravan hot key buttons
[*] Crash when host crashes/leaves and a client saves
[*] Win/loss display, and scoreboard
[*] Switching language from Chinese to English leaves blank boxes for revolt warning
[*] Caravan or Military Hotkeys 
[*] 'Ctrl+C' not functioning in-game correctly to deploy the 'Caravan'
[*] Z & X Hotkeys Conflicting with each other
[*] Dead units remaining as icons in Barracks
[*] Thralls not using happiness goods
[*] Issue when camera pans over mountains above the cloud height locking the camera above the clouds
[*] Military units no longer get stuck in the center of the map[/list]
[h3]Revolts and Riots[/h3]

If the Happiness level of a class of citizens is below a certain threshold for an extended period of time and they do not emigrate or die, the people will find ways to make their voices heard. If 20 or more individuals of the same class are discontent there is now a chance that they may begin to Revolt and eventually Riot. 

[b]Revolt Penalties (per citizen class)[/b] default: under 45 happiness
[list][*] 25% Penalty on Provincial Tax Income (cumulative, per-class)
[*] Associated jobs of that citizen class are ‘Locked’ (citizen cannot be fired)
[*] Locked job slots suffer a 50% Production penalty[/list]

[b]Riot Penalties[/b] default: under 30 happiness
All Revolt penalties plus:
[list][*] Citizens of that class will take to the streets in a large crowd, yelling and waving torches and pitchforks
[*] They will start outside the keep or a random building if there is no keep. After a short gathering period they will move on to start targeting specific buildings 
[*] There will be a chance to set targeted buildings on fire. Mainly production buildings and buildings of higher classes. 
[*] Thralls have a chance to spawn aggressive units(grimrot) that will attack structures.[/list]

[b]Stopping a Revolt[/b]
To stop a Revolt, the player can complete an event, or raise happiness back up to safe levels through the provision of Needs, structures, and other means. Once the Needs have been met, the raging population will be satisfied and life returns to normal.

[b]Thrall Rebellions[/b]
Unlike the other classes, the Thrall class under the heel of a Tyrant are ready and willing to resort to extreme violence to regain their freedom. When this class ends up in a Revolt they will begin to spawn hostile units that will attack structures, as well as your own military units. The only way to quell these groups is through direct force and fulfilling their needs.

[h3]Hired Militia[/h3]
Before a player gains access to more reliable combat units, they have no way to protect themselves in the event of an attack. To tackle this problem, players are now able to temporarily hire citizens into a militia, aimed at dealing with the incursion.

Units will be hired through the keep in groups of “10” except for the scout as an individual. With a limit of 3 contracts out at time. There will be a 1 day delay in re-upping a contract if one is cancelled. Contracts will cost “x” amount of gold initially and will have a continuous fee per day to be active. If you run out of money and can't pay the contracts are cancelled. If units within the “10” die but not the entirety of the group then they will respawn slowly over time. If the group is wiped out completely the contract is cancelled. These units do not require food to sustain life. 

[b]Militia Unit Types[/b]

[u]Militia Bowman (Sling or Bow)[/u]
Capable of weak ranged attacks. They have a slightly lower range than a Bowman, and inflict a paltry amount of damage in comparison. 
[u]Militia Spearman (Spear/Pitchfork)[/u]
The standard rank-and-file militia, these fighters lack much of the punch of a higher quality spearmen, but should be able to at least hold off attackers for a brief time.
[u]Scout (Knife)[/u]
The weakest overall combat unit, the Scout has a simple purpose: Move faster than anyone else, locate potential threats, and get back to safety. See below.
[u]The Scout[/u]

notes.content:

In your feedback across our Discord and Steam forums, you requested for us to add Edge Scrolling, to span across your provinces with ease. [b]Vegetation System Overview[/b]

notes.title: Launch Roadmap Reveal
notes.content:
Greetings! We’ve loved seeing you all playing and taking over the world of Nysamor throughout our first month of [i]Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown[/i]’s Early Access. As we continue to support the game post launch, we’ve crafted a development roadmap to guide you through what lies ahead. 

Your feedback, suggestions and bug reports have been invaluable since we launched, and have helped us shape our plans on the road to full launch in just a few months’ time!  We wanted to begin by expressing how grateful we are for your commitment to ensure your kingdom’s survival. The team has worked tirelessly to deliver the best possible experience in [i]Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown[/i] and there is plenty to look forward to! 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447953/819b07148060164caf67d806bfed90ffff0ed425.png[/img]

This week, our December update includes the ability to use edge scrolling to span across your provinces with ease - a highly requested feature from the community, and much more. 

[b]Amongst the list above, we’re most excited to deliver some major beats in the new year: [/b]

February: 
[list]
[*] Influence System
[list][*] A new feature that limits the amount of provinces, alliances and military units from the start of a new game. This acts like a currency that is spent to acquire more of these items; but once they’re lost and destroyed, the currency returns. When a new game is started, you’ll begin the game with a small amount of influence, which scales with your province's population or upgrade level of your Keep. You’ll never lose influence bonuses even if  your population decreases. 
[/list][*] Militia 
[list][*] Before a player gains access to more reliable combat units, they have no way to protect themselves in the event of an attack. To tackle this problem, players should be able to temporarily hire citizens into a militia, aimed at dealing with the incursion. New unit types will include:
[list][*] Bowman (sling or arrow)
[*] Spearman (spear or pitchfork)
[*] Scout (knife)[/list][/list][*] Riots 
[list][*] If the Happiness level of a class of citizens is below a certain threshold for an extended period of time and they do not emigrate or die, the people will find ways to make their voices heard. Immediately after a Revolt begins, citizens of that class will take to the streets in a large crowd, yelling and waving torches and pitchforks. Property damage and penalties on Provincial Tax Income can occur! 
[/list][/list][list]
[*] Decorative Buildings
[list][*] Including the ability for players to decorate their cities in a unique way, regardless of what level you’re at - neutral, Benevolent or Tyrannical. Giving your structures a new look also combats pollution and improves the beautification of the province, which impacts civilian happiness and the bonus output of the structures themselves.  
[/list][/list]
April:
[list]
[*] Improved Wyrmaxa  
[list][*] Wyrmaxia are the hostile, antagonistic communities of Nysamor that want you off their land and focus on destroying your town. We’ve made tweaks to the intelligence of the patrols, attacks and defences during battle that will improve the combat with each encounter.[/list]
[*] Wall Functionality
[list][*] With every wall you place to defend your province in battle, you’ll be able to move them with ease, plus you’ll see an improved destruction animation each time the enemy damages them. 
[/list][/list]
These releases are only a part of what's to come - alongside them, we’ll continuously work on hotfixes and improvements to the game. This is a journey we embarked on together and we couldn't have asked for better rulers to lead us to prosperity. From all of us, thank you for your ongoing support!

[i]Trust your instincts, and there’s no doubt that you’ll Thrive. [/i]

notes.content:
[b][h2]Greetings fellow Nysians,[/h2] [/b]Today marks a huge milestone as we prepare to release our first major title, Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown, which has today launched into Early Access on Steam. We’re also offering a [b]20% discount[/b] for players that pick up the game before 10AM 13 November PST/ 7PM 13 Nov CET/ 5AM 14 Nov AEDT, so jump in and start your reign of the Kingdom of Nysamor now.

[previewyoutube=scEHpsaF1_w;full][/previewyoutube]
Our hearts are full of gratitude, excitement, and, honestly, a little disbelief. Four years ago, a team of passionate friends came together with a dream to bring Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown to life. We believed in a story and a world that we hoped would mean as much to you as it does to us. Every part of Thrive: HLTC was crafted with love, and knowing that you've been there cheering us on has meant the world.

To those of you who have followed us from the very beginning, thank you for believing in us. Your encouragement during the tough times, your feedback, and every single message kept us going. We couldn’t have reached this milestone without your support and dedication.

To new players just joining us, welcome! We’re thrilled to have you here, and we can’t wait for you to step into this world we've spent years building. We hope it brings you joy, sparks your imagination, and maybe even inspires you in some way.

As you explore the game, know that you’re part of something special, a community that helped make this dream a reality. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for being part of this journey. We’re excited to hear your stories, your adventures, and to share this world with each of you.

With endless gratitude,
[i]- Branden, CEO/Creative Director[/i]

[b][h2]Early Access FAQ[/h2][/b][list][*] Why is Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown coming out in Early Access?
[list][*]We’re releasing Thrive into Steam Early Access so that players can experience all the game already has to offer, with up to 20+ hours of single player campaign gameplay! We also hope to incorporate player feedback into our updates in the leadup to 1.0 to make the game as best it can be at full release in 2025. [/list]
[*] What can I expect in the Early Access launch of Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown? [list][*]Collect and harvest resources and build your legacy through effective planning, advancement and a detailed tech tree. [*] Place city structures, set up road networks, build defenses, and assemble a powerful military to exert your will.[*] Secure your kingdom’s reputation through choices in the narrative event system across three distinct Acts, that allow you to make tough decisions that can permanently alter the lives of your people, your settlement, and the world around you.[*] Choose whether your reign is Benevolent or Tyrannical. A Benevolent ruler shows compassion, while a Tyrannical ruler takes pleasure in exploitation and torture - both paths have their advantages and challenges. Be mindful of the legacy you want to leave behind.[*]Adventure in a single-player experience for solo play or play in up-to-four-player Co-Op or PVP multiplayer.[*]Siege castles, plunder trade routes, or confront fantastical Waelgrim creatures in RTS combat, alongside or against other players. [/list]
[*] What languages will be available in the Early Access launch?[list][*] We’ve localised our game in English, French, German, Spanish, Russian and Simplified Chinese.[/list]
[*] What are my goals in the Early Access launch?
[list][*] As you begin your journey to take over your kingdom in Nysamor, we want players to enjoy the fundamental building blocks of survival city building games - build, fail, optimize, admire and progress! Make moral choices during your reign that impact the lives of your civilians; take your open lands and turn it into a bustling kingdom as you accomplish progression goals and unlock new features.[/list]
[*] Can I pause/quit at any time and come back later?
[list][*] Yes, in both single player and multiplayer modes, it is possible to make incremental saves and exit to return to your game. [/list]
[*] How will I know when I’ve reached the ‘end’ of the game (for now)?
[list][*]Even in Early Access, Thrive is designed to be played as long as you like. As you dominate neighbouring provinces in the world of Nysamor to take over Wymaxia, you’ll progress through the challenges and succeed at achieving the goals of the type of rule you wish to become - will you be a Benevolent ruler, or a Tyrannical authoritarian? Whatever way you choose to pursue, each has their own exciting outcomes. [/list]
[*] Is there somewhere I can find more information about how to play Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown?[list][*] Yes! Visit our [url=https://www.youtube.com/@ThriveHLTC]YouTube channel[/url] for developer walkthroughs, trailers and deep dives on our gameplay mechanics and more, including our upcoming Steam blogs. [/list]
[*] What are the PC System Requirements for Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown?[list]The minimum requirements are a 64-bit processor and operating system, plus: [list][*]OS: Windows 10[*]Processor: Intel Core i5 4690 @ 3.5 GHz | AMD Ryzen 5 1600x @ 3.6 GHz or better. [*]Memory: 16 GB RAM[*]Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 980 [*]Network: Broadband Internet connection[*]Storage: 5 GB available space[*]Sound Card: Integrated[/list][/list][list]Recommended requirements:[list][*]OS: Windows 10[*]Processor: Intel Core i5 4690 @ 3.5 GHz | AMD Ryzen 5 1600x @ 3.6 GHz or better.[*]Memory: 16 GB RAM[*]Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD® Radeon™ RX 580 (8 GB).[*]DirectX: Version 12[*]Network: Broadband Internet connection[*]Storage: 15 GB available space[*]Sound Card: Integrated[/list][/list]

notes.title: Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown - Steam Next Fest Demo Now Live!
notes.content:
People of Nysamor,


We’re super excited to share that - ahead of our participation in Steam Next Fest next week - our first public demo for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1245250/Thrive_Heavy_Lies_The_Crown/]Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown[/url] is now available!

[previewyoutube=ZG6TeFFl4A8;full][/previewyoutube]

There is a whole new world of content to explore in Nysamor, including Multiplayer, Waelgrim Surges, our first Waelbeast encounter, the AI controlled Wyrmaxa Kingdom, and a ton of updated and improved gameplay systems.

The Next Fest Demo includes over ten hours of gameplay, alongside countless fixes and enhanced AI encounters for those that experienced our Closed Beta in December. Importantly, this is your final chance to experience [i]Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown[/i] prior to our Early Access launch later this year! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447953/54ec945c2709400f12a079bc86c2be853f3c0905.png[/img]

Download the demo NOW via [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1245250/Thrive_Heavy_Lies_The_Crown/]Steam[/url] and join in the conversation on [url=https://discord.com/invite/thrivehltc]Discord[/url]! 

Be quick! The demo will conclude on February 12. We will have more exciting details to share on Early Access in the coming months, but we hope you enjoy this slice until then. 

Will you be a kind or cruel ruler? It’s time to find out!

[h2][b]DEMO FAQ[/b][/h2]

[b]What is Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown?[/b]

Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown is a medieval fantasy city builder where the decisions you make weigh heavily on the fate of your kingdom. In Nysamor, you and your citizens will transform a settlement into a kingdom, staking your claim on its provinces while meeting the essential needs and demands of your people. A mysterious, devastating force known as the Waelgrim also lurks in these lands, but the Nysians do not fear it. The roaming Grimrot and ruling Wyrmaxans embrace its power, and see it as a gift. As your reign shifts toward a path of Benevolence or Tyranny, you too must decide if the Waelgrim becomes something to be honored…or subdued.

[list][*]Grow a formidable kingdom, with more than thirty unique buildings and dozens of resources. 
[*]Address the needs of your people and kingdom through events and specializations to reflect your style of rule. 
[*]Amass a grand army and challenge the Grimrot, Wyrmaxans, or other players in RTS combat.
[*]Compete with friends and foes in multiplayer with up to four players.[/list]

[b]What will the demo include?[/b] 

The demo features:
[list][*]Updated gameplay: 
[*]City Building
    - Resource Collection
    - Population Growth
    - Trade Routes
    - Combat including NPC combat with Grimrot and Waelbeast
    - Multiplayer
    - Waelgrim surges and first Waelbeast encounter
    - Wyrmaxan AI faction
[*]Narrative complete up to Act 1 (same as Closed Beta) 
[*]Estimated 10 hours of play time 
[*]Supported languages: English, French, Spanish, German, Russian, Simplified Chinese
[*]Changes based on beta feedback:
    - Fixes to the tutorial flow 
    - Multiplayer improvements
    - Performance optimisation 
    - UI improvements[/list]

[b]What feedback did you take on board from the Closed Beta build?[/b] 

Our Closed Beta late last year was a tremendous success, so we thank you all for taking part. Players should now expect considerable upgrades across performance, graphic textures, lighting, various UI elements, onboarding, combat, fires, disease, attacks, trade, the strategic map, and, of course, multiplayer. Some of the changes we have made are below:

[list][*][b]Separate builder class: [/b]Builders now deliver all resources to construct the build, taking the load off the Stockpile workers. This also allows buildings to be constructed anywhere in a province. 
    - Builders can have townspeople added to the job and removed but it is not part of the priority list on the job menu anymore. 
    - The job menu is now drag and drop using the left mouse click and hold and drag into priority. 
[*][b]Wyrmaxa Kingdom[/b] is now a major threat to the player. Patrols the map, attacks the player, and does not like players building relationships with AI towns. Players can defeat the Wyrmaxa Kingdom, but you best be prepared…
[*][b]Adderbeasts [/b]will attack your kindgom with Waelgrim surges. 
[*][b]UI improvements:[/b]
    - Most icons have been adjusted or colorized in some way to be more visible.
    - Camp worldspace icons are more visible.
    - The War and Demolish buttons have been separated from the placeables buttons in the Build Bar to more clearly separate their functions.
    - Updated Event UI for further clarity based on Beta feedback.[/list]

[b]What can I expect in the Demo versus the Early Access launch?[/b]

While many of the Early Access anticipated features are present in the Demo, there are some items that are either still being tweaked and polished, or being withheld to build up anticipation for Early Access and Full Release.

In Early Access, you can expect:
[list][*]Forty (40) additional buildings
[*]Twenty (20) more craftable items
[*]Discovering your path: Benevolence or Tyranny
[*]Four (4) new classes of citizens once the Benevolent/Tyrannical paths are unlocked (two for each)
[*]Acts II and III of the main narrative arc, along with Random and Building Specialization events
[*]Increased military units and options
[*]And more…[/list]

—————

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447953/775b88fb56afdcbe577aeab9fd4428af443d5ec9.png[/img]

People of Nysamor,

[i]Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown[/i]’s [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1245250/view/3781395613880698473?l=english]Closed Beta[/url] is live, and we’re happy to confirm that [b]all ThriVIP members and applicants[/b] have been granted access. We’ve been humbled by the response so far and are excited for more of you to venture into the world of Nysamor. 

If you haven’t signed up yet, you can request Playtest access via [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1245250/Thrive_Heavy_Lies_The_Crown/]Steam[/url] now and our team will work to grant you access immediately! As a reminder, the Beta ends 11th December, 4PM MST, so get in quick.

[h2][b]CLOSED BETA UPDATE[/b][/h2]

Thank you all for reporting bugs and issues, this is very helpful to our team! Our intention with the Closed Beta was always to closely monitor game performance and actively seek feedback from our players. From your feedback, we've been able to identify several issues affecting some of our player base, including performance, AI and pathfinding issues impacting caravan mechanics, multiplayer desyncs and UI improvements. To that end, we have just released the first patch, V0.0.0.134 which should include fixes across all of the above. Full patch notes, along with notes and known issues can be found below. 

[i]Please note that this update will sadly cause a loss of save files and game progress for our early Closed Beta players. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, but unfortunately were unable to find a solution to maintain save progress with updated builds through the Closed Beta period.[/i]

As mentioned, we'll continue to monitor game performance, and your feedback throughout the Closed Beta, so please continue to share any issues you may run into in Discord.

Don’t forget to check out our Helpful Hints below to learn more about your first journey in Nysamor.

[h2][b]PATCH NOTES[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed issues with Events starting but quickly disappearing, causing progress to halt.
[*]Fixed issue with players getting stuck during an Event conversation.
[*]Fixed issues with units getting stuck while pathfinding.
[*]Fixed issues with desync during multiplayer matches.
[*]Fixed bugs loading into the multiplayer menu both client and host side.
[*]Added multithreading to unit move calculations.
[*]Fixed issue where the Farmers assigned to a Resource Flag would continue to work on their assigned resource node when the AOI (Area of Influence) was no longer contained in that node.
[*]Fixed issue where the same resource can be added multiple times in the top resource bar from the dropdown menu.
[*]Fixed issue where removing and then adding a worker to a building with another worker already assigned no longer results in their animations overlapping.
[*]Fixed an issue with loading where units may not responding to users.
[*]Add space-to-pause.
[*]Esc menu no longer blocked by Event UI.
[*]Added Event UI minimizing.
[*]Fixed locked upgrades not locking correctly
[/list]
[h2][b]NOTES & KNOWN ISSUES[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]We are aware of an issue affecting frame rates and memory usage. Please make sure to enable V-SYNC and restart your computer.
[*]Some labels on buttons may be displayed as ‘Default’
[*]Multiplayer load times are longer than expected. 
[*]Localization is still in progress; certain text prompts may display incorrect information.
[*]Some animations may not seem 100% correct with villagers appearing to walk in place outside buildings where they are assigned to work, or performing incorrect actions.
[*]Fires in the early game may feel overwhelming. Ensure that you have placed Wells within the Area of Influence, and have villagers working at Wells. This should enable you to extinguish them.
[*]Some buildings may not seem to generate their resources. Ensure that the structure has access to a Primitive Stockpile/Stockpile in range (or more than one!) and is not overworked. If this does not solve the problem, demolish and rebuild the structure to solve the issue.
[*]Apple production may feel slow. Ensure plenty of apple orchards are planted to support the village.
[*]Edict menu may behave unusually during onboarding. This will cease once it is complete.
[*]UI popups may appear on top of each other - and you can continue to play the game while they are open. This applies to Tutorial steps, Menus and Narrative Events.
[*]Events currently do not pause gameplay, as the intent is to be able to minimize them and revisit as-needed. This feature is coming soon.
[*]Within the Jobs menu, the Tavern icon may incorrectly display the Farmer icon.
[*]The count of resources may spill over the allotted space within the top bar HUD
[*]You can only prioritize one building at a time. This is an intended limitation.
[*]You are unable to delete a trade route once it has been created. You can, however, change the resource slots as desired.
[*]Waelgrim Surges are present but will be expanded in Early Access.
[*]The game may take a long time to exit to the main menu (after building a large village)
[*]Loading and Saving the game can take some time to complete.
After the ‘Preparing for Expansion’ tutorial step, you will need to establish a proper settlement and not just a wheat farm, for the settlement to properly function.
[*]You will need a Grim Stores to properly deal with Waelgrim Crystal. It can be unlocked through Events.
[*]The Tome of Knowledge (research tree) can be accessed through your Keeps UI, or via the top-left menu. The second button from the left (Sword and Book icon) represents this tree, and will allow you to unlock various new elements of gameplay.
[/list]
[h2][b]HELPFUL HINTS[/b][/h2]
[i]We’ve includes some helpful tips and tricks to getting started in Thrive[/i]
[list]
[h3][b]Preparing for expansion[/b][/h3]
[*]When deploying a caravan, the placement has to be within range of a stockpile – but not too close
- An alert (red triangle) may show on the menu pop-out that there is no storage within range
This is a minor bug – and the caravan can be filled with resources
- Press the purple button to automatically load the caravan; it may take some time to load, but the caravan will be loaded with stones, rocks and farmers for settling in a new province
- Players need to press the green deploy button to continue through the tutorial

[h3][b]Cultivating Wheat[/b] [/h3]
[*]Once they have traveled to a new province, players need to deploy the caravan using the button on the caravan popup HUD
- Select the Traders Hut after pressing deploy (this is not highlighted)
- Begin building in a new province

[h3][b]Creating Trade Routes[/b][/h3]
[*]Ensure the caravan is packed before starting this step to enable the creation of trade routes
[*]Within trade routes, tooltips will display ‘default’ 
- The food category is represented by the fish icon
- Wheat is the yellow icon (next to the water drop
[*]To assign a caravan, press the ‘Add Caravan’ button near the top of the trade menu
[*]Introduction of edicts step 1/3 may appear before pressing the Accept button at the bottom of the Trade menu
- It currently activates with the trade menu open (before the accept button is pressed to begin a trade route)
[*]You are unable to send villagers between villages through the trade route menu

[h3][b]Understanding Edicts[/b][/h3]
[*]The Edict button is not highlighted when this tutorial is activated
- It is the red button between Jobs and Trade
- To view the Edict associated with Taxed Food Delivery, you need to scroll down in this menu
[*]To construct a Smelter, the 20 laborers required is the count among all villages
- The Smelter is found within the Laborers menu
- The smelter can be constructed in either the starting or second village established

[h3][b]Military Preparations[/b][/h3]
[*]Ensure the smelter is functioning to generate Iron Ingots to construct the Armory
- When activating a smelter, ensure that you are generating enough Firewood
- In order to produce military rations, ensure a Pork Ranch is constructed (found within the farmers menu)
[*]Currently in the Beta build Hunting Lodge can be built anywhere including the starting province and it will produce the hide you need regardless of what animals
[/list]
—————

notes.title: Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown: Sign up now for the Closed Beta!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447953/775b88fb56afdcbe577aeab9fd4428af443d5ec9.png[/img]

People of Nysamor,

We are delighted to announce our biggest playtest yet, and [i]you[/i] are invited to get in on the action!

Our upcoming Closed Beta kicks off from 29th November, 4PM MST to 11th December, 4PM MST, giving our dedicated fans plenty of time to test all the latest features and functionality of [i]Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown[/i].

Want access? Request Playtest access via [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1245250/Thrive_Heavy_Lies_The_Crown/]Steam[/url] now! Existing ThriVIP members will be able to access the Closed Beta via the previous key shared from past playtests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447953/f506ee15f69d38a40a798f1502e95bef2f5f2c45.png[/img]

Zugalu Entertainment takes its commitment to its community seriously and it is through your feedback that the game will grow. So join Discord to stay up to date with all Closed Beta details, Q&A times with developers and connect with other players to trial Multiplayer.

[b]CLOSED BETA FAQ[/b]

[b]What is Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown?[/b]

Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown is a medieval fantasy city builder where the decisions you make weigh heavily on the fate of your kingdom. In Nysamor, you and your citizens will transform a settlement into a kingdom, staking your claim on its provinces while meeting the essential needs and demands of your people. A mysterious, devastating force known as the Waelgrim also lurks in these lands, but the Nysians do not fear it. The roaming Grimrot and ruling Wyrmaxans embrace its power, and see it as a gift. As your reign shifts toward a path of Benevolence or Tyranny, you too must decide if the Waelgrim becomes something to be honored…or subdued.

[list]
[*]Grow a formidable kingdom, with more than thirty unique buildings and dozens of resources. 
[*]Address the needs of your people and kingdom through events and specializations to reflect your style of rule. 
[*]Amass a grand army and challenge the Grimrot, Wyrmaxans, or other players in RTS combat.
[*]Compete with friends and foes in multiplayer with up to four players.
[/list]
[b]What are the objectives of the Closed Beta?[/b] 

This Closed Beta gives our development team a chance to share the world we have built so far, and to learn from the experiences of our playtesters. Precious feedback on the concepts we have implemented, the mechanics in place, and the look and feel of Thrive will guide us forward into 2024, where future showcases, Early Access, and our full release await. Any issues or bugs that we can resolve during this Closed Beta will only help to ensure Thrive is a fresh, engaging addition to the city building genre.

[b]What are the key differences since the last ThriVIP build?[/b] 

Our last closed beta was in April, when we released build 106 to a small group of ThriVIPs. So much of the game has changed since then, both in terms of building off of their feedback, as well as implementing many systems and mechanics that were still in development at the time. Issues addressed include performance, graphic textures, lighting, various UI elements, onboarding, combat, fires, disease, attacks, trade, the strategic map, and, of course, multiplayer. We are excited to see what new feedback will arise from all that has been added and changed.

[b]What can I expect in the Closed Beta versus the Early Access launch?[/b]

While many of the Early Access anticipated features are present in our Closed Beta, there are some items that are either still being tweaked and polished, or being withheld to build up anticipation for Early Access and Full Release.

In Early Access, you can expect:
[list]
[*]Forty (40) additional buildings
[*]Twenty (20) more craftable items
[*]Discovering your path: Benevolence or Tyranny
[*]Four (4) new classes of citizens once the Benevolent/Tyrannical paths are unlocked (two for each)
[*]Acts II and III of the main narrative arc, along with Random and Building Specialization events
[*]Increased military units and options
[*]And more…
[/list]
—————

Until we next meet…
